columns.affected_supply_usd: supply at t0 in USD; an Euler lending vault weighted by the share of its debt backed by the event's family
columns.date: UTC day of t0: for a depeg-loss event the onset of the episode after which the collateral did not recover, for a lock-up the first trigger
columns.exposed_curators: distinct curator entities of those vaults (blank: no curator registry)
columns.exposed_vaults: curated vaults with >= 10k USD in the markets at t0
columns.exposure_third_party_usd: positions at t0 of curated vaults whose curator is not the collateral's issuer and that are not self-deposited, each market weighted by the share of its debt backed by the family (Euler lending vaults net of the Earn vaults that supply them)
columns.exposure_third_party_usd_peak_after_t0: peak over day ends from t0's day to the event end of the daily sum of the same positions, guarded against phantom accrual
columns.first_trigger: UTC day of the earliest trigger of any hit (first_trigger_any); earlier than date only for depeg-loss events with a lock-up episode before the loss
columns.main_text_rank: rank among events that are not self-curated (first 15)
columns.min_market_price: minimum collateral price in peg units
columns.self_curated: every vault exposed to the family is curated by its issuer
